ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing used to capture ROM data into rdata and to sample rden. It sequences the two clocked processes that update rdata and rden.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in mem_access and bus_feedback processes that assign rdata and rden

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Acts as an asynchronous active-low reset for rden, forcing rden to '0' when asserted and thereby overriding its normal clocked update.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then rden <= '0' in bus_feedback process (sensitivity list includes rstn_i)

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Encapsulates request fields; addr is used to index ROM, and stb/rw form the read-enable sampled into rden. Other fields are not used in this source.
role: provides addr, stb, rw to logic
ports.evidence: port declaration and individual field uses (addr, stb, rw) in processes

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Supplies the address bits used to index the boot ROM; the address expression selects which ROM word is captured into rdata in the mem_access clocked process.
ports.evidence: Used as index in rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(boot_rom_size_index_c+1 downto 2)))) in mem_access

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request bundle but not read or used in this source.
ports.evidence: Declared in port bundle only; no references elsewhere in this entity

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the request bundle but not referenced or used by this entity's logic.
ports.evidence: Port field present in declaration with no uses in processes or assignments

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Combines with inverted rw to form the read-enable sampled into rden; used in the bus_feedback clocked process to determine rden's next value.
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) in bus_feedback process

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Indicates read/write and is inverted and ANDed with stb to produce rden; read (rw='0') allows rden to be asserted when stb is true.
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) in bus_feedback process

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared in the request bundle but not read or used in this source.
ports.evidence: Port field present in declaration with no references in the entity

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Part of the request bundle but unused by any logic in this entity.
ports.evidence: Declared in port but not referenced elsewhere

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Provided in the request record but not consumed by this entity's code.
ports.evidence: Field declared in port bundle with no uses

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the request record but not used in this source.
ports.evidence: Port field present only in declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Part of the request bundle's opcode field but not referenced by any logic here.
ports.evidence: Declared but never read in this entity

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Included in the request bundle but not used by the ROM logic in this entity.
ports.evidence: Port field present with no references

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared in the request record but not referenced in any process or assignment in this entity.
ports.evidence: Port declaration only; no usage in source

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Exports the response fields ack, err, and data to the external bus. The individual fields are driven inside this entity and together form the response record.
ports.evidence: Port declaration and per-field concurrent assignments to bus_rsp_o.data, bus_rsp_o.ack, bus_rsp_o.err

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Driven directly from rden and reports when read data is being presented; it follows rden combinationally to assert acknowledgement to the bus.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Constantly driven low here; this entity always reports no error by driving err to '0'.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Conditionally presents rdata on the bus when rden is '1'; otherwise outputs zeros. It is derived from rdata and gated by rden.
ports.evidence: Concurrent conditional assignment bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')

signals.name: rden
signals.functionality: Samples bus_req_i.stb AND (not bus_req_i.rw) on clk_i and is asynchronously cleared by rstn_i. It enables the ROM data and ack outputs when set.
signals.evidence: bus_feedback process: reset branch sets rden<= '0'; on rising_edge(clk_i) rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)

signals.name: rdata
signals.functionality: Captures the ROM word selected by bus_req_i.addr on each clock edge and supplies that value to the response data output when enabled.
signals.evidence: mem_access process captures mem_rom_c(address) into rdata; bus_rsp_o.data uses rdata in conditional assignment
